verdict.rationale: Asana documents an official MCP server and Claude app that turn AI chats into structured tasks, plus AI Teammates with shared memory that carries context forward from the Work Graph. It also offers two-way sync integrations (Jira, GitLab, Bitbucket, and others, including comments and custom fields), webhooks, and rule-driven handoffs that pass task context to tools like PagerDuty. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that context survives handoffs intact, and documentation of explicit agent-to-agent handoff between external agents and AI Teammates.
